gen-gf-turret-road-gf-glegoo: Commanding, parenthesis-round letters set the tone in Turret Road, drawn with a pen-like line of constant weight. Glegoo then lets its tall, wide-mouthed lowercase breathe beneath all that swagger.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-hanuman: Round forms like open parentheses give Turret Road its bold look, every stroke a constant pen-like line. But Hanuman sits in a more traditional register, its high-waisted lowercase finishing s with wide-set terminals.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-slabo-13px: Turret Road draws bold, round letters whose stroke edges run parallel through every curve, giving the heading a commanding presence. Slabo 13px stays bookish and dignified, its open counters inviting steady reading.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-suwannaphum: Never swelling or thinning, the stroke of Turret Road gives its round forms a commanding, pen-like drive. Suwannaphum meets it with a dignified, editorial lowercase that stands tall, its c opened like a bent paperclip.
gen-gf-twinkle-star-fs-bespoke-sans: Tightly spaced, hand-written letters whose curves open outward give Twinkle Star a graceful, casual lilt. But Bespoke Sans is the sharper one, with generous space where curves meet the stem, and happiest in brief spurts.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-hanuman: Hanuman brings a traditional, refined voice, its high-waisted lowercase finishing s with wide-set terminals. Underdog is the shouter here, its horseshoe-wide c and unvarying stroke made for commanding display.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-kadwa: Underdog never shifts weight along a curve, its c opening like a horseshoe. Kadwa, with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, carries a page of paragraphs with editorial ease.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-pridi: Underdog holds its weight steady through every curve, its c opened wide like a horseshoe for an expressive, commanding display. Pridi stands proud in its lowercase, so paragraphs move along with refined ease.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Wide-eyed and sharp, Unica One gives every curve visible daylight and every stroke a uniform thickness. While BhuTuka Expanded One slows to a leisurely, literary walk, its joins no thinner than its stems.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-hanuman: Unkempt skims along with a t whose crossbar matches its stem. Hanuman supplies the traditional, refined counterweight, its high-waisted lowercase giving the expressive heading a taller partner on the page.
